gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-almendra-sc: Almendra SC is a dignified text serif with mouths that stay open on c, e and a, while Cowboys traces its rustic letters like glass tubing. Big gaps between stems let the two sit side by side.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-antic-slab: Cowboys draws every letter as a laser-etched line of constant width, with wide gaps between the stems. Antic Slab follows in round-bowled serif, editorial and dignified, so the heading can go a size or two bigger.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-arvo: Rustic and wiry, Cowboys looks like pipe cleaner bent into letters, with wide gaps between stems. Arvo, a traditional serif with curves that refuse to close, would swallow it if the heading were made small.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-belgrano: Belgrano is a classic serif whose open-mouthed curves stay clear, set under Cowboys, whose letters look drawn with one pen tip and spaced wide. Longer text feels traditional and unhurried.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-biorhyme-expanded: Wire-thin and rustic, Cowboys spaces its stems far apart. BioRhyme Expanded, a refined text serif with an open e and wide gaps between letters, gives that spare heading a bookish partner with real presence.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-biz-udmincho: Cowboys is a rustic display face with big gaps between stems and thin joins no lighter than the stems. BIZ UDMincho, a bookish text serif with shallow terminal curls, feels like old print beside a glowing wire.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-copse: A constant-width trace, like a laser-etched line, gives Cowboys its rustic, authoritative look, with an s whose spine matches its terminals. Copse, a literary text serif, lets daylight through every curve.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-cutive: Cowboys has no hairlines anywhere, just a rustic constant-width line and wide gaps between stems. And Cutive, a refined classic serif with generous c openings and wide tracking, brings the literary side.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-david-libre: David Libre keeps its terminals hanging open, dignified and refined in a serif way. And Cowboys is the louder one, a steady, rustic line with no pressure variation and big gaps between stems.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-enriqueta: Bent-paperclip strokes make Cowboys rustic and authoritative, with big gaps between stems. And Enriqueta, a literary classic serif whose chalk curves stop well before closing, keeps a long page dignified.
